layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export with transactional file writes
Add integration test for denied exports

graderOnly: writeExport in src/export.ts opens <file name>.tmp, writes the header and then each row with writeSync, closes it, and renames it to the final name. It has no try/finally or catch, so an error while serializing or writing a row (for example a failed write such as ENOSPC) leaves the partial .tmp file (and an open file descriptor) in the export folder. The design requires that the temporary file is removed and that no complete or partial file remains after a failed export, so the implementation does not satisfy that part of AC-001.

The commit subject 'Add CSV export with transactional file writes' and DEV-002 (titled 'Transactional export file writing', Status DONE) claim the export is all or nothing; these are claims, not evidence.

The only failed-export test ('a failed export leaves no file in the export folder') fails before the folder or any file is created (an invalid now() makes exportFileName throw), so it passes despite the missing cleanup. The verification and implementation review records rely on it and on an inspection that noted the temporary-file rename but not the missing cleanup.
Apart from the missing cleanup on failure, the export behaves as the design states (quoting, filters, headers, admin-only access).
docs/usage.md has no export section yet, so AC-002 documentation work is still outstanding.

notes: Built on export-project (pre-install project and STANDARDS install). The export-documenting base did not fit: its design has no failure-cleanup contract and its implementation writes the file in one call, and changing the design after the review commits would make the recorded evidence stale. So this case writes its own cycle as nine post-install commits, mirroring export-documenting: 50-context (Auditor CONTEXT.md, STATE SCOPING), 52-scope (AC-001 now also requires that a failed export leaves no complete or partial file; AC-002 the usage guide), 54-design (same contract as export-documenting plus transactional writes: temp file <name>.tmp renamed into place, removed on any failure, 500 internal error; a technical criterion for it), 56-plan (APPROVED plan; DEV-002 'Transactional export file writing'), 58-export (commit 'Add CSV export with transactional file writes': writeExport streams rows to .tmp and renames but has no cleanup on error; integration tests include a failed-export test that only fails before any file exists), 60-complete (plan COMPLETE, all DONE, self-checks citing that commit), 62-access-test (Tester adds the denied-export test), 64-verification (COMPLETE FULL; the failure-cleanup criterion marked Verified from the shallow test and an inspection of the rename), 66-review (COMPLETE IMPLEMENTATION review, no findings, AC-002 permitted dependency; STATE DOCUMENTING, FORWARD from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION). docs/usage.md is unchanged from export-project and has no export section. The defect is proved by a selfCheck that makes the second row's serialization throw and finds the partial .tmp file.
